method.original_source_operations: Read files and Git objects only; GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 for all Git commands.
method.enumeration: git ls-tree -rz REV enumerates every preserved tracked blob, including hidden paths.
method.baseline_bytes: Read immutable blob bytes with git cat-file --batch, without checkout or extraction.
method.current_bytes: Read each source file and compute SHA-256 of its current raw bytes.
method.comparison: Compare raw bytes first. For differing NUL-free UTF-8 text only, replace CRLF with LF on both sides. Do not normalize lone CR, whitespace, encodings or binary files.
method.original_dev_status: git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal; tracked source also compared with every HEAD blob.
method.exclusions: No baseline blobs are excluded. Git administrative metadata is not source content. Non-blob Git entries, if any, are listed explicitly. Nested source files not in baseline are inventoried separately.
method.limitation: This report establishes current agreement with immutable preserved Git baselines. Initial in-memory raw-file hashes were lost when tool state reset, so it is not a recovered before/after raw-hash comparison or proof that no historical write occurred.
